name: Rumi
source:
A friend of Rami the imp, Rumi traveled with her to Succubus Village to train and help her avenge her humiliation at Luka’s hands. An incredibly weak monster, there’s almost no threat unless you’re overconfident. No matter how weak she is, you must never forget that she can prey on men if they let her weaken them first.

[Edited from In-game Monsterpedia]
